t: THE MYSTERIES OF THE LIFE OF CHRIST OUR LORD › OF THE MYSTERIES DONE FROM THE HOUSE OF CAIPHAS TO THAT OF PILATE, INCLUSIVE

items.e: First Point. First: The whole multitude of the Jews take Him to Pilate and accuse Him before him, saying: “‘We have found that this man tried to ruin our people and forbade to pay tribute to Caesar.’”
Second Point. Second: Pilate, after having examined Him once and again, said: “‘I find no fault.’”
Third Point. Third: The robber Barabbas was preferred to Him. “They all cried, saying: ‘Give us not this man, but Barabbas!’”
